{{Quote|Captain Silver out. Head for home. Lightspeed.|Silver to the crewman of his ship|<ref name="R2 Come Home">{{TCW|R2 Come Home}}</ref>}}
'''Silver''' was a [[Clone Captain/Legends|clone trooper captain]] who commanded a [[Pelta-class frigate/Legends|''Pelta''-class frigate]]. Silver rescued the survivors from the explosion on board the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Venator-class Star Destroyer]] [[Endurance/Legends|''Endurance'']]. He was waiting for [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] to give the word on [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Shoan Kilian/Legends|Shoan Kilian]] and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Ponds/Legends|Ponds]]. However, he was later told there was no sign of Kilian or Ponds in the wreckage and to leave by Anakin Skywalker and Mace Windu. He then transported the survivors to the near by medical station.
